
Four problem sets, each worth a total of 75 points, will be assigned throughout
the semester. These will cover applications of the methods discussed in class
to a variety of data sets. Each homework assignment will be submitted online
through Gradescope.  

Each homework assignment will be due at 5:00pm on Friday, with an automatic 
grace period lasting until the following Monday at 8:00am. During the grace 
period, course staff will not typically answer questions, so make sure to ask 
any questions well in advance of the deadlines. You do not need to request 
this grace period; it will be automatically applied. 

Other than the standard grace period, no late work will be accepted on any 
homework outside of **exceptional** circumstances. (Non-hospitalizing 
illness, extracurricular conflicts, or commitments for other courses are not 
considered exceptional, so plan ahead.) If you have a foreseeable circumstance
that you believe warrants an extension, please contact the instructor or the
TA well in advance; no extensions will be given for foreseeable circumstances
without specific prior written authorization.

After each assignment is submitted, the instructor or TAs may require students
to meet and to discuss their submissions. Students who are not able to clearly
demonstrate understanding of their submissions will be significantly penalized.
